events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock vibes
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for peace, love, and three days of music. What's your ultimate Woodstock track?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King of Rock and Roll. His music still sounds as fresh as ever. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Influential American rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur. His words continue to resonate through generations. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi's genius
angles.copy: 56 years since the world lost a true guitar icon. Jimi Hendrix's influence is still felt in every riff. What's your top Jimi track?

events.title: Abbey Road album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Iconic album cover
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That zebra crossing shot is still instantly recognisable worldwide. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman and iconic figure in British rock, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock and roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's acclaimed second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that still resonates today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: iPod launch anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remember the iPod?
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod and changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the release date of the first film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring spirit
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, what's your favourite of his iconic roles?

events.title: 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The iconic White Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. So much incredible music across two discs. What's your must-listen track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
